title: touchmark doctor report
description: The report of touchmark doctor (doctor/v1): the checks of each provider's write identity, of every target of targets.yml, and of the hub (write isolation; with --hub-token, where the write key lives). A check the write identity cannot read is unknown, never ok. A non-public target of a public hub is only counted: its entry has no path, no repository id and no check details.

strict.description: The run had --strict: a check that warns or is unknown, or an incomplete resolve, exits with code 3.

hub_token.description: doctor --hub-token read, with a maintainer's token, where the hub keeps its secrets.

hub_checks.description: The checks of the hub itself.

providers.description: The hub's providers, in hub.yml order.

targets.description: Every target, sorted by provider and path; targets a public hub does not name come last within their provider.

warnings.description: Warnings about the run as a whole.

summary.description: Checks per status, every status present.

fingerprint.description: The hub's host and immutable repository id, e.g. github.com/712345678; on Bitbucket the repository UUID, lowercase without braces.

commit.description: Full commit id: 40 or 64 lowercase hex digits.

check.description: What was checked, e.g. access, token-expiry, rules, markers, hub-hidden, write-isolation, key-location.

detail.description: What the check found; absent for a target the report does not name.

host.description: The provider's host, with a port when it has one.

writer.description: Login of the writer hub.yml names.

self.description: Login the write credential acts as.

resolve_complete.description: Every organisation and group of targets.yml was listed in full.

missing.description: Repositories targets.yml names that the platform does not know, as <provider>:<path>.

error.description: Why the provider could not be checked.

checks.description: The checks of the write identity.

repo_id.description: The repository's immutable id on the platform; empty for a target the report does not name.

path.description: The repository's canonical path; empty for a target the report does not name.

skipped.description: Why the target was not checked: archived, disabled, empty, mirror, pending-deletion, prs-disabled, sha256, not-opted-in, opted-out, unsafe-opt-in, or deferred:<reason> (the run could not check the target; an unknown check says why).
